sources.title: Google Books metadata page for Good to Great
sources.role: primary edition metadata and publication-family confirmation
sources.notes: Confirms the title, Jim Collins as author, HarperCollins as publisher, October 16, 2001 metadata, 320 pages, and the canonical long subtitle.

sources.title: HarperAcademic product page for Good to Great
sources.role: official publisher framing and concept confirmation
sources.notes: Confirms the HarperBusiness trade family and highlights the book's major findings, including Level 5 Leadership, the Hedgehog Concept, a Culture of Discipline, Technology Accelerators, and the Flywheel and the Doom Loop.

sources.title: Jim Collins Concepts Map
sources.role: official concept map linking the book's core ideas
sources.notes: Confirms the staging from disciplined people to disciplined thought and disciplined action, and shows the official placement of Level 5, First Who, the brutal-facts discipline, the Hedgehog Concept, the Flywheel, and Culture of Discipline.

sources.title: Can You Grow into Level 5 Leadership?
sources.role: authorized support for Chapter 2 and the leadership frame
sources.notes: Supports the Level 5 idea as humility plus will in the transition from good to great and reinforces the rarity of that leadership profile in the study set.

sources.title: First Who, Then What
sources.role: authorized support for Chapter 3 and for the people-before-direction mechanism
sources.notes: Confirms the get-the-right-people-on-the-bus concept and its use under uncertainty.

sources.title: The Stockdale Paradox
sources.role: authorized support for Chapter 4 and the brutal-facts discipline
sources.notes: Supports the chapter's dual demand: confront brutal facts while maintaining faith in eventual success.

sources.title: Hedgehog Concept in the Social Sectors
sources.role: authorized support for Chapter 5 and the three-circle logic
sources.notes: Confirms the three intersecting circles and the discipline of saying no to opportunities that fail the hedgehog test.

sources.title: Good to Great article page
sources.role: official support for the broader study findings and later-chapter flywheel logic
sources.notes: Used to support the study framing, the long time horizon, and the interplay between the book's main concepts.

sources.title: Good to Great - A Summary to Make a Leap Yourself
sources.role: chapter-order confirmation and chapter-level support where official public text is thin
sources.notes: Provides a clean nine-chapter map and concise chapter summaries that align with the official concept pages and publisher framing.
